caseName: Johnson v. U.S. Dist. Court for the N. Dist. of Cal.
caseNameFull: Charles Wayne JOHNSON, aka Qasauca Jalil Amura v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the NORTHERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA.

opinions.text:
Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.

Justice BREYERtook no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
